findings.description: No blocking defect remains in the round-3 remediation boundary. (1) proxy_complete_work omits ambient agent_id/agent_type; the bridge omits agent_id when None; the /work/complete and /work/submit endpoints resolve identity from the authenticated principal, so HTTP atomic submit and complete share one principal. (2) The async submission OSError branch routes through the fail closure and the status OSError branch completes the claimed ledger as failed; both have new tests asserting one failed completion. (3) When ingestion and ledger completion both fail, the error is ingestion error followed by ledger error, covered by a test asserting both substrings. Regression sweep: migration 043 replaces the 042 collision with test and learning notes updated; SDK adapter still rejects non-review modes before key resolution; manifest now records async_dispatch, task_id and ledger_task_id; lock cleanup, API, work-queue ownership and envelope schema files are unchanged relative to round 3; the removed try_get_work import and ambient AGENT_ID read leave no dangling references. Caveat: this reviewer could not re-execute pytest or Ruff in this sandbox (approval required), so the reported 177/152/1002/281 pass counts, Ruff clean and OpenSpec 93/93 are accepted from the supplied evidence rather than independently reproduced.
